drafts.subject: This week on the courts: Nov 30–Dec 6
drafts.why_time: Sunday 5pm is the club's usual slot; only if approved by 4:30pm, otherwise Mon Nov 30, 7am.
drafts.body:
Hello from the racquets desk. Here is the week of Nov 30–Dec 6.

MONDAY Nov 30
7–8:30am  Early bird drill (Tennis, Tennis 1) · 3.0 and up
10am–12pm  Open play (Pickleball, Pickleball 1) · All members
4–5:30pm  Junior development (Tennis, Tennis 2) · Ages 8–15
6:30–8pm  Men's doubles ladder (Tennis, Tennis 3) · Ladder field

TUESDAY Dec 1
4–5:30pm  Junior development (Tennis, Tennis 2) · Ages 8–15
5:30–7pm  High school prep (Tennis, Tennis 3) · Ages 14–18
6–8pm  League play (Platform tennis, Platform 1) · Club league

WEDNESDAY Dec 2
9–10:30am  Adult clinic 2.5–3.0 (Tennis, Tennis 1) · Developing
4–5:30pm  Junior development (Tennis, Tennis 2) · Ages 8–15
6:30–8pm  Women's doubles ladder (Tennis, Tennis 3) · Ladder field

THURSDAY Dec 3
9–10:30am  Adult clinic (Tennis, Tennis 1) · 3.0 and up
4–5:30pm  Junior development (Tennis, Tennis 2) · Ages 8–15
6–7:30pm  Evening round robin (Pickleball, Pickleball 1) · All levels
6–8pm  League play (Platform tennis, Platform 1) · Club league

FRIDAY Dec 4
9–10:30am  Adult clinic (Tennis, Tennis 1) · 3.0 and up
10am–12pm  Open play (Pickleball, Pickleball 1) · All members
4–5:30pm  Junior development (Tennis, Tennis 2) · Ages 8–15

SATURDAY Dec 5
9–10am  Beginner clinic (Pickleball, Pickleball 1) · New players
9:30–11:30am  Saturday match play (Tennis, Tennis 1) · 3.5 and up
11am–12:30pm  Junior match play (Tennis, Tennis 2) · Ages 10–16

SUNDAY Dec 6
9–11am  Sunday round robin (Platform tennis, Platform 2) · All members
10–11:30am  Adult drill and play (Tennis, Tennis 3) · 3.0 and up

Courts closed all week for construction: Pickleball 3 and Pickleball 4.
No pickleball is scheduled on Tuesday or Wednesday this week.
A few sessions are still being confirmed and are not listed yet (7). The online calendar updates as soon as they are.

See you on the courts,
The racquets desk
